policy.name: original
policy.priority: Existing system/user bytes and placement; no instruction promotion.

models.availability: Requires recorded smoke test; no replacement if unavailable.
Requires recorded smoke test; no replacement if unavailable.
Requires recorded smoke test; no replacement if unavailable.

settings.sampling: Provider defaults; no temperature, seed or reasoning-effort override.
settings.response_format: Existing live OpenRouter behavior: json_object for roles, absent for prose.
settings.baseline_output_limit: Provider default; preflight cap is removed.
settings.retry_note: CLI retries follow runner parse/transport failures. Live provider retries transport failures only; game API/browser retries retriable failed turns, including parser/admissibility failures.
settings.preflight_engine_output_limit: Provider default; smoke engine uses Sonnet, whose worst-case reservation fits the smoke cap.

limits.future_spending: No N2/N3 spending authorised by this manifest.

heldout.source: Fresh hand-authored independent stories, mechanically validated before narration. Different hidden-spot, any/all-use, line, and physical gates; source artifacts are sealed.
heldout.seal: No held-out narrator calls or output inspection before final candidate freeze. Prompt tuning retires the entire mystery.

order.fixed: For case index i, repetition r, position p, model=(i+r+p)%3; identical states across models.
order.games: For story index i and persona index p, rotate model order by (i+p)%3. One game at a time, detective then kid-7.

major: Material contradiction or invented case-bearing fact
Premature disclosure, including an unearned concession or gated tell
rubric.readability: Flesch tolerance 2 plus age_appropriate_turn and human review; formula alone is not ground truth.

layers.cli: Parsed requested role output; semantic expect checks do not establish full engine admissibility.
layers.games: Engine-admitted play; rejected turns remain failures even if later retried.

rubric.failures: Retain every requested sample and attempt. Report parser, semantic/admissibility, infrastructure, timeout, quit, divergence, incomplete and judge errors separately; none becomes success by exclusion.

acceptance.selection: Apply independently to every frozen model/policy; report met and unmet criteria. No deployment/default change in measurement. Keep current choice when evidence does not justify a change.
acceptance.uncertainty: Report per-mystery denominators and 95% intervals. Repetitions are correlated; do not present turns or games as independent mysteries.

human_review.major_findings: All flagged major findings against source facts and prior turns.
human_review.passed_selection: Deterministic hash ordering, stratified by story, requested role and model; round each stratum up.
human_review.blinding: Packet omits model/policy identities; identity key retained separately. Human ratings remain pending until the operator supplies them.
human_review.ground_truth: Model judges and judge agreement do not replace human adjudication.

retention.raw: Normal run folders plus transport request/response/usage records in the private archive.
retention.index: baseline.json beside this manifest; immutable hashes reference private artifacts.
retention.reproduction: Retain bindings, dataset, inputs, source hashes, code commit, CLI versions, all requests and responses, usage and latency.
